div.p: 12,000 on-campus residents across 18 residence halls and apartment complexes. 14 dining locations serving globally inspired, nutritionist-approved meals — from all-you-can-eat dining halls to specialty cafés.
Purpose-built for first-year students. Double and triple rooms with shared bathrooms, communal study lounges, and a live-in Resident Advisor on every floor.
For sophomores and above. Private bedrooms grouped around a shared lounge, kitchenette, and en-suite bathrooms. Located at the heart of the social campus zone.
Self-contained studio and one-bedroom apartments for graduate students and families. Full kitchen, in-unit laundry, and dedicated parking. Quiet study-focused community.

div.p: 14 dining locations across campus — from our flagship 800-seat Main Dining Hall open 7am–midnight, to specialty restaurants, grab-and-go cafés, and late-night snack bars.

div.p: Housing applications are only available to confirmed students. Accept your offer and pay the enrollment deposit to unlock the housing portal.
Log in to the Housing Portal at housing.Axion.edu. Select your preferred residence type and roommate preferences.
Select a meal plan during the housing application. All on-campus residents are required to have at least the Flex 10 plan in their first year.
Room assignments are sent via email in July for Fall semester. You can request a reassignment within 2 weeks of receiving your assignment.
Move-in takes place the Friday before classes start. You'll receive a scheduled time slot to avoid congestion. RAs will be on hand to help you settle in.

From Model UN and robotics teams to salsa dancing and film-making guilds — there's a community at Axion for every passion, background, and ambition. Can't find what you're looking for? Start your own club.
Browse over 200 organizations grouped across 6 categories — from STEM and arts to cultural identity and community service.
Discipline-specific societies, honor societies, industry networks, and career development clubs for every major.
80+ organizations celebrating the diversity of Axion's student body — from national cultural societies to language exchange clubs.
Orchestra, jazz band, theatre company, photography guild, student newspaper, podcast collective, and film society.
Volunteer networks, environmental action groups, political organizations, and social justice advocacy clubs.
Hiking club, esports team, chess league, cooking society, yoga collective, board games society, and more.
Startup incubator teams, hackathon clubs, innovation challenge squads, and the Axion Ventures student fund.

div.p: One of the largest MUN clubs in the US. Competes at Harvard MUN, NYUMUN, and hosts the annual AxionMUN conference attended by 1,200+ delegates.
Three-time national champions in collegiate robotics. Open to all students regardless of major. Runs weekly workshops on hardware and software engineering.
Student-run venture fund managing $500K in seed capital. Has invested in 18 student startups, 4 of which have raised follow-on funding from external VCs.
120-piece student orchestra. Performs four concerts per semester at the Axion Performing Arts Center. Auditions open at the start of each semester.
Student-led environmental advocacy group. Runs campus sustainability campaigns and partners with the CCSS research center on climate awareness events.
Award-winning student newspaper published weekly in print and daily online. Covers campus news, investigative journalism, opinion, arts, and sports.

The SGA is the official representative body of the student population, liaising between students and university administration. It allocates the $2M+ student activity budget, organizes campus-wide events, and advocates for student welfare.

div.div: 60 elected representatives across all schools and class years, plus a 5-member executive cabinet.
$2M+ annual budget allocated to clubs, campus events, services, and student welfare initiatives each year.
Elections held each April for the following academic year. Any registered student may run for office.

div.p: If you don't see a club that matches your passion, start one. Axion provides funding, meeting space, marketing support, and an administrative mentor to help any student launch a new organization.
Gather at least 10 interested students and identify a faculty or staff advisor willing to sponsor the club.
Complete the New Organization Charter form via the Student Life portal with your mission statement, officers, and constitution.
The SGA reviews applications monthly. Approved clubs receive an initial budget of up to $1,500 and a dedicated space for meetings.
NCAA Division I athletics, 2,000+ intramural participants, and world-class facilities — because being an Axion Storm means more than just showing up to class.
Axion competes at the NCAA Division I level as a proud member of the Atlantic Collegiate Conference (ACC). Our 24 varsity programs are committed to excellence on and off the field.

div.div: Back-to-back conference champions, advancing to the NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 for the first time in program history.
Men's team claimed the conference championship; three swimmers earned All-American honors at the NCAA Championships.
16 programs earned ACC Academic Honor Roll. 92% four-year graduation rate — among the best in Division I.

div.p: You don't have to be a varsity athlete to compete. Over 2,000 students participate in intramural leagues and club sports every semester.

div.p: 7,500-seat multi-purpose arena for basketball, volleyball, and major campus events. Renovated 2022 with modern video boards and expanded seating.
Open to all students. Features 3 NBA-size courts, Olympic pool, fitness center with 200+ machines, racquetball, and indoor track.
NCAA-standard 50-meter competition pool plus a separate diving well with 1m and 3m boards. Home to the championship swim and dive programs.
Natural-grass soccer and lacrosse fields plus a synthetic-turf practice field. 3,000-seat grandstand with lights for evening matches.
400m all-weather track with field event areas plus an adjacent 2,200-seat baseball stadium with a modern press box and locker facilities.
12 outdoor courts plus 4 indoor courts. Varsity courts include stadium seating for up to 500 spectators. Open for student recreation when not in varsity use.

Prospective student-athletes can connect with coaches, explore scholarship opportunities, and learn about life as an Axion Storm.
Comprehensive physical and mental health services — because thriving academically starts with feeling your best. All services are confidential and available to every enrolled student.

div.div: Your wellbeing is our priority. All health and counseling services are confidential. Students enrolled in the university health plan receive services at no additional cost. Walk-ins are welcome during regular hours.
div.p: Located in the Axion Wellness Center on North Campus, our Student Health Center provides primary and preventive care to all enrolled students. Board-certified physicians, nurse practitioners, and registered nurses staff the clinic year-round.
Diagnosis and treatment of acute illness, minor injuries, and chronic condition management. Same-day appointments available for urgent concerns.
Stay ahead of illness with routine screenings, immunizations, and annual wellness exams. Required vaccinations can be verified or administered here.
On-site lab for rapid testing and routine blood work. Results typically available within 24–48 hours, with urgent results communicated directly by your provider.
On-campus pharmacy dispenses most common prescriptions at reduced cost for students. Over-the-counter medications and wellness supplies are also available.

The Axion Counseling Center provides free, confidential mental health support to all enrolled students. Our licensed therapists, psychologists, and counselors are here to help you navigate life's challenges.

div.class: side-nav border-0 text-center p-4 h-100 reveal
div.p: One-on-one sessions with a licensed counselor. Available weekly with a limit of 12 free sessions per academic year. Extended sessions available on a sliding-scale basis.

div.class: side-nav border-0 text-center p-4 h-100 reveal reveal-delay-1
div.p: Structured group sessions on topics like anxiety, depression, relationship skills, grief, and identity. New groups form each semester — no session limit.

div.class: side-nav border-0 text-center p-4 h-100 reveal reveal-delay-2
div.p: Video and phone sessions available for students who are remote, studying abroad, or prefer virtual care. Schedule through the student portal.
If you're in immediate distress, same-day crisis appointments are available. Walk in to the Counseling Center or call our 24/7 crisis line.
Free access to our digital mental wellness platform. Mood tracking, guided meditations, CBT exercises, and 24/7 AI chat support — available on iOS and Android.
Drop-in guided meditation sessions every Tuesday and Thursday at noon. Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction (MBSR) 8-week program runs each semester.
Free yoga classes at the Recreation Center: Hatha, Vinyasa, and Restorative. Adaptive yoga available for students with mobility concerns.
Sleep hygiene workshops, individual consultations, and the SleepWell nap lounge — a quiet rest space in the library open 24/7 during finals.
Trained peer wellness educators host workshops on stress, relationships, and alcohol safety. Available for dorm floor programs and student organization events.
Confidential STI testing, contraception counseling, relationship support, and bystander intervention training through the Safe Campus Initiative.
Pop-up de-stress events during midterms and finals: therapy dogs, art therapy, aromatherapy, and free snack breaks — watch the campus event calendar.

All full-time students are automatically enrolled in the Axion Student Health Plan (ASHP), administered by BlueShield Academic. The plan provides comprehensive coverage including primary care, specialist referrals, hospitalization, mental health, and prescription benefits.

div.span: Add spouse or child to your plan

div.p: Students with comparable private insurance may waive the ASHP. Opt-out requests must be submitted by September 15 (Fall) or February 1 (Spring) through the Student Portal.
Enrollment in ASHP is mandatory for all F-1 and J-1 visa holders. The plan meets all federal visa health insurance requirements.

Free one-on-one sessions with a registered dietitian. Get personalized guidance on balanced eating, managing dietary restrictions, fueling athletic performance, or building healthy habits on a student budget.

50+ interdisciplinary research centers tackling the world's most complex challenges — from climate change and pandemic preparedness to quantum computing and AI ethics. $400M in annual funding powers research that makes a global difference.
Each center brings together faculty, doctoral students, and industry partners to work on problems that matter to the world.
Pioneering research in deep learning, reinforcement learning, AI ethics, and human-AI interaction. Partner of Google DeepMind, Microsoft Research, and OpenAI.
Translational medicine, cancer biology, genomics, and neuroscience research connecting bench science to clinical application in our partner hospital network.
Climate modelling, carbon capture, renewable energy, and environmental policy research in partnership with the UN Environment Programme and national governments.
Cutting-edge research in FinTech, cryptocurrency regulation, behavioral economics, and global capital markets. Advisory board includes former central bank governors.
Pandemic preparedness, infectious disease, maternal health, and health systems research. Field sites in 35 countries across Africa, Asia, and Latin America.
Superconducting qubits, quantum cryptography, and quantum communication research. Operates a 127-qubit quantum processor — one of six in the world accessible to university researchers.
Our grand challenge initiatives bring together researchers from multiple disciplines to attack problems too complex for any single center.
Cross-disciplinary effort to develop AI systems that are fair, explainable, and aligned with human values — in partnership with the EU AI Office.
Achieving carbon neutrality by 2030 while producing research on carbon capture, green building, and renewable microgrids adopted globally.
Whether you're an industry leader, government agency, or NGO — our research centers are open to collaboration. Fund a fellowship, sponsor a lab, or co-investigate with our faculty.
